allowed_kinds.when: Multiple materially different paths remain after deterministic ranking; human chooses objective/tradeoff, not implementation detail.
The next state transition requires hands, presence, device access, postage, photography or other unavailable physical action.
A platform requires identity, OTP, KYC or account-owner action.
QP policy requires human approval before real spend/irreversible economic action.
A customer/partner relationship requires human judgement, negotiation or trust-building.
The unresolved variable is a genuine owner preference/creative strategic choice rather than a missing fact.

anti_patterns: asking the human to debug code
asking the human to read logs the agent can read
asking broad open questions without bounded options
escalating because worker confidence is low when an external test is available
